system.description:
A character with any Unliving Archetype gains the following shared base modifications.

A character with any Unliving Archetype gains the following shared base modifications.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SHARED BASE MOD RULES EFFECT
------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Darkvision The character gains Darkvision. If the character already has Darkvision, this grant has no additional effect.

Immunity to Disease The character is immune to disease effects.

Immunity to Soul Drain The character is immune to Soul Drain.

Immunity to Subdual The character is immune to subdual damage and subdual effects.

No Need to Breathe The character does not need to breathe and cannot suffocate from lack of air.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

On the sheet: the Unliving trait (Requiem, Embalmer's Black Resin and every "Unliving trait" rule read it); immunity to disease (the Disease trait), Soul Drain, subdual damage and effects, and the Suffocating condition; no breath to hold (the drowning and suffocation rules pass the character over). Darkvision is a separate ability the archetype grants, and a second grant of it is skipped.
